headline: Raj Television Network reports a change in its board of directors
hook: Boardroom shuffle at Raj Television Network
summary: Raj Television Network Limited has officially notified the stock exchange regarding a change in its directors. Specific details regarding the incoming or outgoing personnel were not disclosed in the preliminary filing. Routine board changes at micro-cap media firms have minimal direct impact on broader market indices. Indian retail investors holding the stock should monitor subsequent disclosures for specific names and strategic shifts.
why_it_matters: Routine management tweak with negligible impact on your portfolio.

headline: Raj Television Network submits scrutinizer report and voting results for its 32nd AGM
hook: Routine procedural filing from Raj Television
summary: Raj Television Network has submitted the scrutinizer report and voting results of its 32nd Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the exchange. This is a standard compliance filing required after the conclusion of a company's annual shareholder meeting. For an Indian retail investor, this administrative update carries no direct financial or operational impact.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for retail shareholders from routine AGM filings.
